name: plutocms-supabase
description: The Supabase integration of Pluto: the Supabase layer and its shop and blog layers

scripts.postinstall: bun run --cwd packages/supabase dev:prepare && bun run --cwd packages/supabase-shop dev:prepare && bun run --cwd packages/supabase-blog dev:prepare
scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/supabase build && bun run --cwd packages/supabase-shop build && bun run --cwd packages/supabase-blog build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/supabase typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/supabase-shop typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/supabase-blog typecheck
scripts.test: bun run --cwd packages/supabase test && bun run --cwd packages/supabase-shop test && bun run --cwd packages/supabase-blog test
